location_description:
Marlton is a census-designated place (CDP) located within Evesham Township in Burlington County, New Jersey. As of the 2010 U.S. census, Marlton's population was 10,133.Though Marlton is only a small part of Evesham Township, many people colloquially use "Marlton" to refer to the township as a whole.


== History ==
Marlton was founded by Welsh and English farmers beginning in 1676.
